name: form
description: Wraps the fields and buttons of a form: Enter in a field submits it, a missing or invalid value stops the submit and takes focus, and server errors passed as validationErrors show in the field with that name until the user changes its value and leaves it. Put FormActions last, with the submit button last inside it; both are exported from the form file. The example's fields and buttons come from the text-field and button components.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called on submit once every field is valid; call event.preventDefault() to handle it in JavaScript.

props.name: action
props.description: Where the form submits: a URL, or a React server action.

props.name: validationErrors
props.description: Errors from the server, keyed by field name, e.g. { email: "This email is already taken" }. Each shows in its field until the user changes the value and leaves the field.

props.name: validationBehavior
props.description: Applies to every field inside: native validates on submit; aria validates as the user types.

example:
<Form onSubmit={signUp} validationErrors={serverErrors}>
  <TextField name="email" type="email" isRequired>
    <TextFieldLabel>Email</TextFieldLabel>
    <TextFieldInput />
    <TextFieldError />
  </TextField>
  <FormActions>
    <Button variant="secondary">Cancel</Button>
    <Button type="submit">Sign up</Button>
  </FormActions>
</Form>
